_comment: INDUSTRIAL: a pedestal crane with its jib raked up and out along +Z - the builders hoist things, and a hoist parked at a deck corner is the shortest way to say this hull is a workplace. The rule turns it OUTWARD, so the jib leans overboard the way a real davit stows: ready to swing a load off the side. The hook block hangs free under the tip. NO yellow - the accent is disciplined to edges, collars and handles, and a crane is silhouette, not paint; restraint on the accent is what keeps the band reading. Second-tallest piece in the kit after the stack, and rationed the same way.
